data.name: Barbell Bench Press
data.description: A compound press that builds chest thickness, triceps, and pressing power from a stable bench.
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Unrack with locked elbows and lower the bar to mid-chest.
Press up in a slight arc until elbows lock without bouncing.
Keep shoulder blades pinched and a natural arch in the back.

data.name: Pull-Up
data.description: An essential bodyweight exercise that targets the upper back and biceps for strength and width.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull your chest up to the bar by driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Pause briefly at the top before lowering with full control.

data.name: Back Squat
data.description: The king of lower body movements for building leg power, quad strength, and core stability.
instructions: Rest the bar across your upper back and unrack.
Break at the hips and knees simultaneously to lower into a deep squat.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position.

data.name: Overhead Press
data.description: A strict vertical pushing movement targeting the shoulders and upper chest.
instructions: Hold the barbell at collarbone level with a tight core.
Press the weight straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the bar back to collarbone level with control.

data.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
data.description: An isolation movement designed to build bicep peak strength and arm definition.
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides.
Keep elbows close to your torso and curl the weights towards your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

data.name: Hollow-Body Plank
data.description: A core isometric exercise that strengthens abdominals and pelvic stability.
instructions: Support your weight on forearms and toes.
Engage your core and keep your back completely flat.
Hold the posture firmly without letting hips sag.

data.name: Conventional Deadlift
data.description: A total body posterior-chain movement building hamstrings, glutes, and back power.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and mid-foot under the bar.
Hinge at hips, grip the bar, flatten back, and pull chest up.
Drive through legs to stand upright locking hips at top.

data.name: Push-Up
data.description: A classic bodyweight exercise targeting chest, shoulders, and triceps.
instructions: Place hands shoulder-width apart on the ground.
Lower body until chest almost touches the floor.
Push forcefully back to starting plank position.

data.name: Walking Lunge
data.description: A dynamic unilateral leg exercise that improves balance, quad, and glute strength.
instructions: Step forward with one leg and lower hips until both knees bend at 90 degrees.
Push through front heel to step forward into the next stride.

data.name: Russian Twist
data.description: A rotational core exercise that targets the oblique muscles.
